confirmed_decisions.decision: Persist one department ActiveDelegateEmployeeId as the current effective-manager authority. Add department-scoped leave tracking with yellow pending and green approved days, actor attribution, and an all-department on-leave roster for HR/elevated users. Revalidate correct-format XLSX import through the real UI.
